warnings.message: Yarn (Berry): dependenciesMeta takes package names only; "@scope/*" not written
warnings.fix: List the package names in installScripts.allow

warnings.message: Yarn (Berry) has no setting for remote tarball dependencies, so "deny" cannot be enforced
warnings.fix: Run depcurfew doctor, which reports such dependencies in the lockfile

warnings.message: Yarn (Berry): npmPreapprovedPackages in .yarnrc.yml (line 2) exempts react from the release-age delay, but cooldown.exclude in depcurfew.json does not; depcurfew apply comments it out, so Yarn (Berry) delays it like every other package
warnings.fix: To keep the exception, add "react" to cooldown.exclude in depcurfew.json and run depcurfew apply again
